title: ACP turns run as GAWD missions
goal: CEO direction 2026-11-12 ("Integrate ACP into gawd layer"). The ACP pillar on 9094 was served by the GAWD A2A server but executed by core's `SubstrateAcpExecutor`, which answered every `session/prompt` with `acp-ack[<session>]: <prompt>`: no ACP prompt ever reached an agent. `GawdAcpExecutor` (susi-gawd-a2a) implements `AcpTurnExecutor` by running the turn's text as the same GAWD mission an A2A task runs (`plane_bus::gawd::solve_mission`), behind the same untrusted-content gate (`enforce_action`, Consequential), the same in-flight capacity permit and the same reply/error redaction; an empty prompt or a failed mission is an error, and a turn cancelled before it starts runs no mission. `server::app` takes the ACP executor and mounts `AcpEngine::new(default admission, GawdAcpExecutor)`; JSON-RPC and SSE turns run on `spawn_blocking` so a mission does not hold an async worker. Core's `acp.rs` is unchanged (carbon's T-CTOCORELEAN-1 holds it).
limitations: A mission cannot be interrupted midway: session/cancel during a running mission reports the turn cancelled and drops the answer, but the mission itself runs to completion.
A mission's answer arrives as one delta, not token by token.
The ACP stdio transport (`AcpStdioTransport`) is not wired to GAWD by this change; it is only reachable where a host constructs it.
The turn runs in the daemon's working directory, as A2A tasks do; the session's `workspace` is not passed to the mission.

results.end_to_end: 2026-11-12, isolated instance (scratch SUSI_HOME, offset 7300, core daemon from this change, commercial plug host attached). On 16394 (9094+offset): public /.well-known/acp.json served; initialize and session/new over POST /acp with the bearer token; session/prompt 'What is the capital of France? Answer in one short sentence.' -> GAWD mission answer 'Paris is the capital of France.' with the mission pipeline's citation warning, stop_reason end_turn, receipt sha256, 931 ms. An injection prompt -> JSON-RPC -32603 '[UNTRUSTED_CONTENT_BLOCKED source=acp:request] embedded instruction refused'. POST /acp/stream -> acp.turn.event frames with the mission's output and acp.turn.result. Before this change every prompt returned 'acp-ack[...]: <prompt>'.
results.tests: susi-gawd-a2a 54 passed / 0 failed, including the new executor test and the route test that now asserts the turn ran as a mission.
